about.title: About Me
description: I'm a versatile Software Engineer driven by a passion for building seamless web and mobile experiences along with robust backend infrastructure. My expertise spans creating high-performance applications using Next.js and React, crafting cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Flutter, and developing scalable Python solutions.

Beyond development, I have a strong foundation in DevOps and Cloud architecture, specializing in CI/CD, automation, and AWS and Azure cloud deployments. I thrive on translating complex client requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technological realities.
